title: Early Access | ContextMint
description: ContextMint coming soon — a frictionless local AI coding assistant for a solo developer, and a shared-control path for a small company or enterprise.

hero.title: Two ways in
hero.leadAfter: . A solo developer starts frictionless on one machine and can turn on controlled checks. A small company or enterprise adds a shared server, SSO, and an admin lock for posture and cloud. Seat pricing stays unpublished until packaging is set with early teams.

cards.name: Solo developer
cards.priceNote: Engine + VS Code extension · local model

features.text: Ask how the codebase fits together, plan a change, and let Agent propose it
Frictionless by default; controlled when you turn on evidence review and patch approval
Optional bring-your-own-key cloud, off until you turn it on
Context Lens before the model answers
Code and the index stay on your machine

cards.name: Small company / enterprise
cards.priceNote: Shared server and SSO for the team

features.text: Admin lock so a developer cannot change posture or cloud
Quality map and operator audit for the team

why.title: Why no public pricing?
why.textBefore: Pricing follows the path: one machine for a solo developer, or a shared on-prem server for a small company or enterprise, plus compliance and scale. Tiers stay unpublished until that packaging is set.

cta.title: Ready to explore fit?
cta.text: Tell us whether you are a solo developer or a team — we will point you at the local install or the shared-server path.
